description: Source code for SEC OpenMAX IL Component Registration, including functions for loading, unloading, and registering components, as well as API checks and dynamic library handling.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_Component_Register
methods.description: Registers components by reading registry file, dynamically loading libraries, and retrieving component info.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_Component_Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters components and frees associated memory.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_ComponentAPICheck
methods.description: Checks if the OMX component has all required function pointers set.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_ComponentLoad
methods.description: Loads a component library, initializes the component, and verifies its API.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_ComponentUnload
methods.description: Unloads a component library and deinitializes the component.
